title: No magic in this gadget!
text: No magic in this gadget!. I purchased the 5.5 qt size model from another source.  I have to wonder about all of the positive reviews and my gullibility believing them.  I had hoped for the taste of deep fried magic, which in retrospect, is unreasonable to hope for without the use of oil. There is no magic in this machine which seems to me to essentially bake foods in a basket, and not well.  The basket on this one is quite large and will hold plenty, so that parts good. But with the food piled deep together, it seems to come  out almost mushy.  I didn't try it for long before returning it to my local retailer, so maybe should have further explored.  But I did do a batch of battered zucchini which came out almost bitter and certainly nothing better than from the oven.. I tried frozen ready made churros.  Came out okay but really nothing special. Think the oven and microwave would have done as well.  Tried chicken nuggets, frozen, not fresh.  Probably my fault on the timing, but came out a bit burned and hard. The air fryer seems to take about the same amount of time as the oven baking. I had somehow thought it was really fast.  Granted, I kind of skimmed the directions on this (I hate reading instruction manuals), enough to learn what buttons to push.  Perhaps I could have learned of more ways to cook with it, and that's on me; however, I was not impressed with the overall performance of the Air Fryer in the way so many others seem to be.  It's kind of nifty looking, something a little different on the counter, but also takes up a fair amount of space with the xl size.
